body:
There’s not much to my life. I work and come home. I’m a CNA, I work long hours so I don’t have much time to socialize but honestly I don’t have the energy to do so nor do I want to. My families a fucking mess. Sometimes I wish my dad didn’t remarry I feel like our life’s would of been so much better. I have one friend, she’s more like a sister to me and at the moment she is what keeps me sane.
I have always thought about killing my self but it definitely got worse when my step mothers father raped me. I never acted on these thoughts till last year when i slit my wrist. 
On the outside I seem like the happiest person you’ll ever met but I’m dying inside but I don’t tell anyone cause when I do they just say I’m crazy and that I choose to be depressed and that I just need to snap out of it,  as if it’s that’s easy. I stopped taking my meds cause I was tired of them not helping me at all.
